run_doaugs_main: run the main function to generate augmented video frames and save them as JPEG images
get_augmentation_files: get all augmentation JPEG image files from a specified directory
parse_filename: parse an augmentation image filename to extract the augmentation type and strength value
generate_table: generate a LaTeX table code from augmentation image files and write it to an output file
run_main_table: run main_table to generate and print a LaTeX table from existing augmentation images
